row: USA Chiropractic Neck & Back Pain Relief

Hi I"m Dr. Jason Tirado and welcome to my channel! I've been practicing for over 30 years getting people out of pain. Using this channel I have been able to reach more people around the world and teach them about the amazing benefits of safe natural chiropractic care which has saved millions of people from unnecessary spinal surgeries and lasting back pain.  For years I have used a safe, precise technique for examining the spine and making corrections. For any questions about this practice, please visit www.westnewyorkchiropractor.com or call (201) 453-1555. This channel will give you a better idea of how I treat patients in my office and if it looks right to you then I want to encourage you to give me a call. And yes... I do answer my phone myself from time to time.  Please subscribe... Dr. Jason Tirado
